Hi Hannah — bringing procurement in.

Short version: Redwood's standard policy requires a PO for new vendor commitments except for low-dollar one-off exceptions. Thresholds: new vendor + invoices totaling >= $5,000 require a PO before work starts. For pilots estimated under $5k we will consider a controlled exception with these conditions: 

- Accounts Receivable must receive the invoice with a clear note: "Pilot invoice — PO to follow (if applicable)"
- Vendor must complete intake (W9/vendor form) and provide SOC 2 summary (already provided)
- Contract/Statement of Work (simple SOW) must be saved to Drive and linked in the vendor record
- Finance will open a pilot exception ticket; exception is timeboxed to 30 days from invoice date

If you approve, procurement will: (1) create the vendor record, (2) mark exception in system, (3) notify AR to accept the single invoice. After the pilot, if ongoing spend is expected, procurement will require a formal PO and standard vendor setup.

I've attached the vendor intake checklist we use when evaluating exception requests. Please confirm you (Hannah) as the business owner approve the exception so we can route to AR.

Attachments: vendor-intake-checklist.xlsx

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
